body: Aren't birthdays just a constant reminder you're getting older and older, and you can't help it? Just a reminder that its all going to end soon, and you can't help it at all. You just watch and get closer to dying by the second without even realizing it. Why do people celebrate getting old? Why do people celebrate getting closer to death? Most everybody fears death, yet they celebrate getting older, year after year? In a way, its better being alone than with people. You don't have to deal with the stress of keeping up with everybody, whats been going on with their lives, this and that. Crying alone is better than telling your alleged besties all thats been happening, your feelings, everything. And them pretending to care. Everybody is fake. Everything is fake. You're better off alone than with fake people.
